==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a virtual world that is almost identical to the waking world. The main difference is that there are obstacles and collectibles placed in different real world areas. My mission is to collect enough iridescent stars, apples, and crescents to win a game.

I find myself inside of a house searching for collectibles, when suddenly the dream shifts. I become aware of people known as Wish Bombers. They have the power to grant their own wishes.

The Wish Bombers are on a mission to eliminate the competition. Scared of the Wish Bombers, I search for a power great enough to stop them. Luckily I discover a friendly dragon who gives me a wishing orb that I use to defeat the Wish Bombers.
